# platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin — Users

> 4 page(s) of platform.claude.com documentation — Api — Admin under Users. Part of the index one level up (../llms.txt).

## Users

- [Get User](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/users/retrieve.md): Retrieve a member of the organization by user ID.
- [List Users](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/users/list.md): ID of the object to use as a cursor for pagination. When provided, returns the page of results immediately after this object.
- [Remove User](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/users/delete.md): Remove a member from the organization.
- [Update User](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/admin/users/update.md): Update a member's organization role.
